en-US.description: A modern, pure frontend music app based on the TuneHub API
en-US.longDescription:
A modern, pure frontend music app that can be easily deployed on CloudFlare Pages / Netlify / Vercel, and also provides a Windows desktop version.
✨ Features
- 🔍 Aggregated Search - Supports combined search from Net**** Music, Ku*** Music, and QX Music
- 📋 Playlist Management - Create, import, and manage custom playlists
- ❤️ Favorites - Easily save and manage favorite songs
- ⏰ Scheduled Playback - Sleep timer with customizable duration
- 🎨 Responsive Design - Perfectly adapts to both PC and mobile devices
- 📱 PWA Support - Installable as a desktop/mobile app, supports media session notifications
- 💾 Smart Caching - Locally caches song information to reduce duplicate requests

zh-CN.description: 一个现代化的纯前端音乐 APP ，基于 TuneHub API
zh-CN.longDescription:
一个现代化的纯前端音乐 APP ，可以在 CloudFlare Pages / Netlify / Vercel 上轻松部署，同时提供 Windows 桌面端。
✨ 功能特性
- 🔍 聚合搜索 - 支持网 XX 音乐、酷 X 音乐、QX 音乐聚合搜索
- 📋 歌单管理 - 创建、导入、管理自定义歌单
- ❤️ 收藏功能 - 轻松收藏和管理喜爱的歌曲
- ⏰ 定时播放 - 睡眠定时器，支持自定义时长
- 🎨 响应式设计 - 完美适配 PC 和移动端
- 📱 PWA 支持 - 可安装为桌面/移动应用，支持媒体会话通知
- 💾 智能缓存 - 本地缓存歌曲信息，减少重复请求
zh-CN.name: InspireMusic
